stories.title: At least 14 Serbians targeted with advanced spyware
stories.summary: Student protesters among those hacked, Share Foundation says, but government denies spying At least 14 people from across Serbian civil society were targeted with advanced spyware earlier this year, the digital rights group Share Foundation has said. The wave of spyware infections was discovered in August after Apple notified people in 110 ⁠countries that they had probably been victims ⁠of mercenary spyware. Share said on Wednesday it marked the largest documented ​wave of such infection in Serbia to date. Continue reading...

stories.title: Fox News Media abruptly ousts longtime anchor Maria Bartiromo
stories.summary: Bartiromo had been a host at the network for more than a decade and Fox gave no explanation for the decision Fox News Media on Thursday abruptly ousted one of its most well-known hosts and anchors, Maria Bartiromo, without providing an explanation. “Effective today, Maria Bartiromo is no longer with FOX News Media,” the network said in a press release, adding in a statement: “We thank Maria for her work over the last 12 and a half years and wish her all the best on her next chapter.” Continue reading...
stories.headline: Fox News Media abruptly ousts longtime anchor Maria Bartiromo

opening: Bartiromo had been a host at the network for more than a decade and Fox gave no explanation for the decision Fox News Media on Thursday abruptly ousted one of its most well-known hosts and anchors, Maria Bartiromo, without providing an explanation.

“Effective today, Maria Bartiromo is no longer with FOX News Media,” the network said in a press release, adding in a statement: “We thank Maria for her work over the last 12 and a half years and wish her all the best on her next chapter.”
